capabilities: Counts words in the active note and shows progress toward a daily goal
Draws word clouds and word-cue charts for feelings, topics, mindset and pronouns
Indexes Daily Notes and extra journal folders into a writing history
Shows word totals, streaks, trends, language composition and a per-day calendar
Lets users edit category word lists and add their own vocabulary
extras: All analysis runs locally with no account, API key or external service; the language charts count literal English word cues and do not interpret negation, sarcasm or other languages. Installation is manual from a release zip.
problem: Obsidian's word count covers only the open note, so there is no built-in view of how daily writing volume, goals and vocabulary change over time.
summary: Local writing-analytics dashboard that tracks word counts, daily goals, streaks, word clouds and topic and tone trends across Daily Notes.
